paragraphs.text: The following characters from an unknown plane are only mentioned in flavor text or on legendary creature cards, appear as minor characters in the storyline , or are otherwise not notable enough to receive their own article.

Ademi of the Silkchutes is a heroic dark skinned human who partners with a parachute-making spider . They are able to temporarily fly via a spider-thread created parachute created by their spider companion who then ties itself to their back via the web. They are the digital Through the Omenpaths counterpart to Spectacular Spider-Man .
Ademi of the Silkchutes
Balefang is a demon dragon and rival of Baneslayer Angels .
Balefang the Unslayable

Generous Betty Wray is a human mercenary on Thunder Junction who is celebrated as a hero . She wears Freestrider clothing and has a long braided ponytail. They are the digital Through the Omenpaths counterpart to Silver Sable, Mercenary Leader .
Chira is a human rogue and treasure hunter.
Gamble ( Eternal Masters )
Gamble ( Judge Gift )
The Clutter Cluster , is a heroic brood of spiders that cleans up household clutter. It was introduced as the digital Through the Omenpaths counterpart to Spiders-Man, Heroic Horde .

Darval , Whose Web Protects , is a heroic spider - human hybrid. He has a human torso with the lower body and legs of a spider. They are the digital Through the Omenpaths counterpart to Spider-Man, Web-Slinger .
Darval, Whose Web Protects

Desecrex is an symbiote villain known as the Gift of Servitude . They appear to be a dark skinned humanoid mass with a glowing red center. They are the digital Through the Omenpaths counterpart to Carnage, Crimson Chaos .
Desecrex, Gift of Servitude
Druneth is a villainous human scientist whose goal appears to be reviving a Sliver hive. They were introduced as the digital Through the Omenpaths counterpart to Jackal, Genius Geneticist .
Druneth, Reviver of the Hive
Elda is a human magician. Her modern clothing and art deco conjuring door may imply that she is from New Capenna .
Elda, Conjurer of Spectacle

Egrix is an symbiote spider hero known as the Bile Bulwark . They appear to be a large spider fused with a dark scaled spiky symbiote. The lower part of the spider glows with the pink. They are the digital Through the Omenpaths counterpart to Gwenom, Remorseless .
Egrix the Bile Bulwark
The Everforger is a construct blacksmith.
Glava is a human mage of the Five Advents.
Glava, Five-Advents Mage
Homer is a crab druid .

Kavaero is a heroic human with the ability to copy the faces of the deceased. It is unclear if this ability was granted by or is related to the spider on their head. They were introduced as the digital Through the Omenpaths counterpart to Superior Spider-Man .
Maular is a dinosaur mutant with two heads.
Maular, the Next Evolution

Rhilex is an symbiote soldier hero known as the Accursed . They appear to be a light skinned human who wears golden armor, wields a sword, and is partially covered in a black amorpious symbiote. They are the digital Through the Omenpaths counterpart to Agent Venom .
Sahir is a human wizard.
Sahir, Visitor in Darkness
Sala is a humanoid squid pirate from an unknown plane. He is a deck boss of a ship with the Keelhaulers and took part in the Ghirapur Grand Prix .

Sarn of the Silken Throne is a heroic human who partners with a cat-sized black spider . They were web-like white armor and have a cape with a black spider-web pattern on its underside. They are the digital Through the Omenpaths counterpart to Spider-UK .
Sarn of the Silken Throne

Skv'x is an symbiote spider hero known as the Augmenter . They appear to be a black scaled symbiote that opens up their purple maw to fuse with a large spider. They are the digital Through the Omenpaths counterpart to Symbiote Spider-Man .

Tethex is an symbiote villain known as the Gift of Malicer . They appear to be a black scaled symbiote with a large purple maw ready to fuxe with another creature. They are the digital Through the Omenpaths counterpart to Venom, Evil Unleashed .
Tethex, Gift of Malice
Tolabow is an otter . It may be from Eldraine , the only plane known to have horned otters and multiple lochs.
Uugguu, the Omniplasm

The Ur-Spider is an ur-entity presumably similar in nature to other Ur- beings like the Ur-Dragon . Its scions are a heroic human and spider duo. They appear on the digital Through the Omenpaths counterpart to Cosmic Spider-Man .
Scions of the Ur-Spider

Verilax is an symbiote hero known as the Havenskin . They appear to be a humanoid creature covered in white scales and spikes. The center of their body glows and they have been observed protecting forest animals from a fire. They are the digital Through the Omenpaths counterpart to Anti-Venom, Horrifying Healer .
Verilax the Havenskin

Viggo is a human hero and villain originally known as the Enforcer of Ig's Crossing until he is fused with a symbiote after which he is referred to as the End of Ig's Crossing . They appear to be a human who wears knight -like armor. He can fuse with a large black symbiote, standing within its glowing pink center. Without the symbiote he is seen protecting a boy from a wolf-like humanoid. After joining with the symbiote he is seen destroying the town he previously was protecting. He is the digital Through the Omenpaths counterpart to Eddie Brock and Venom, Lethal Protector .
Viggo, Enforcer of Ig's Crossing
Viggo, End of Ig's Crossing
The Wardens of Silverweb Summit are a heroic human and spider duo who protect Silverweb Summit. They were introduced as the digital Through the Omenpaths counterpart to Spider-Gwen, Free Spirit .
Wardens of Silverweb Summit
Yera and Oski are a heroic pair consisting of a human guide and a spider. They were introduced as the digital Through the Omenpaths counterpart to Arachne, Psionic Weaver .
Yera and Oski, Weaver and Guide
The following characters from unknown planes are only mentioned in flavor text or appear as minor characters in the storyline .
